etymology: Phono-semantic: 此 (phonetic シ) + thread (糸) — the costliest dye of antiquity: purple.
mnemonic: The thread only royalty could afford — むらさき. 紫式部 wrote under its name.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 支 'branch' (phonetic シ) — the body's branches: limbs.
mnemonic: The trunk's four branches — シ. 選択肢: choices — the decision's limbs.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 咨 (phonetic シ) — asking those below: to consult.
mnemonic: The chairman actually asking — はかる. 諮問: the committee's summons.

etymology: Phono-semantic: treasure (貝) + 易 (phonetic シ) — handed down from above: to bestow.
mnemonic: Received with both hands and a bow — たまわる. 賜る: keigo's gift verb.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 此 (phonetic シ) + bird (隹) — the hen side of the pair: female.
mnemonic: The quieter half of the birdsong — めす. 雌雄: female and male, biology's pair.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 寺 'administration' (phonetic ジ) — one in attendance on a lord: retainer — the samurai.
mnemonic: The one who serves standing — さむらい. 侍: the sword was the side detail.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 茲 (phonetic ジ) + heart (心) — the nurturing heart: mercy, parental love.
mnemonic: The heart that feeds before it asks — いつくしむ. 慈悲: mercy in temple script.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 爾 (phonetic ジ) + jade (玉) — the sovereign's jade stamp: the imperial seal.
mnemonic: The one stamp above all stamps — ジ. 御璽: the emperor's ink.

etymology: Phono-semantic: cart (車) + 由 (phonetic ジク) — the shaft wheels turn on: axle, axis.
mnemonic: What everything else revolves around — ジク. 軸: graphs, scrolls, and arguments all have one.

etymology: Compound: hands clamped in the manacles' grip (幸+丸) — seized fast: to grasp, carry out; refusal to release: obsession (執着).
mnemonic: The grip that outlasts reason — とる, シツ. 執筆: gripping the pen till the book exists.

etymology: Phono-semantic: liquid (氵) + 桼 'sap tree' (phonetic シツ) — the tree's black gloss: lacquer.
mnemonic: Tree-blood polished to a mirror — うるし. 漆器: Japan's glossiest export.

etymology: Compound: illness (疒) striking arrow-fast (矢) — disease; arrow-speed itself: swift.
mnemonic: The arrow that brings the fever — シツ. 疾走: running like the arrow, not the patient.

etymology: Phono-semantic: plants (艹) + 之 (phonetic シ) — the low spreading grass: lawn.
mnemonic: Grass cut to golf height — しば. 芝居: theater — once played on the lawn.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 赤 (phonetic シャ) + 攵 — the rod lowered: to forgive.
mnemonic: The sentence commuted at the red seal — シャ. 恩赦: the state's rare mercy.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 余 (phonetic シャ) + 斗 'ladle' — poured at a tilt: slanting.
mnemonic: The ladle that can't pour straight — ななめ. 斜め: the angle of mischief.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 者 (phonetic シャ — itself originally 'boiling') + fire (灬) — the pot at work: to simmer.
mnemonic: 者 finally gets its fire back — にる. 煮物: the simmered side dish.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 庶 (phonetic シャ) — stepped into the path: to block.
mnemonic: The crowd closing the road — さえぎる. 遮断機: the railway crossing's arm.

etymology: Compound: 虫 (originally the viper) + 它 (also originally a snake) — doubly serpent: snake.
mnemonic: The creature so snake it's written twice — へび. 蛇口: the faucet — a tamed snake's mouth.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 牙 (phonetic ジャ) + city (阝) — crooked ways: wicked, evil; the body's invader: 風邪.
mnemonic: Tusks inside the city walls — ジャ. 邪魔: evil's polite little brother — 'excuse the intrusion'.

etymology: Pictograph: the sparrow-shaped bronze wine cup of investiture — the rank it conferred: peerage.
mnemonic: The cup that made you nobility — シャク. 男爵: the baron — and the potato named after one.

etymology: Compound: jar (酉) + ladle (勺) — pouring for another: to serve; to weigh circumstances (酌量).
mnemonic: The ladle at the jar, reading the room — シャク. 晩酌: the evening pour.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 釆 'distinguish' + 尺 (phonetic シャク) — untangled and let go: to explain, release; Shakyamuni (釈迦).
mnemonic: The knot explained until it unties itself — シャク. 解釈: interpretation, licensed.

etymology: Phono-semantic: roof (宀) + 叔 (phonetic ジャク) — the hushed house: still, lonely; Buddhist tranquility (寂滅).
mnemonic: The house after everyone left — さびしい. わび寂び: loneliness aged into beauty.

etymology: Ideograph: a tree with its red heartwood marked — the red pigment: vermilion.
mnemonic: The red inside the trunk — シュ. 朱印: the shrine's vermilion stamp.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 歹 + 朱 (phonetic シュ) — set apart from the rest: special, particular.
mnemonic: The one marked in red — こと. 特殊: filed under 'exceptional'.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hound (犭) + 守 (phonetic シュ) — the managed chase: to hunt.
mnemonic: Dog and warden working the woods — かり. 紅葉狩り: hunting autumn leaves, harmlessly.

etymology: Phono-semantic: jade (王) + 朱 (phonetic シュ) — the round treasure: pearl.
mnemonic: The gem the oyster signs in red — シュ. 真珠: the true pearl of Mikimoto.

etymology: Phono-semantic: run (走) + 取 (phonetic シュ) — where one's interest runs and takes hold: flavor, intent, hobby.
mnemonic: What you chase for no salary — おもむき. 趣味: the weekend's true employer.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 需 (phonetic ジュ) — the scholar society requires: Confucian.
mnemonic: The needed man with the classics — ジュ. 儒教: the curriculum of empires.

components: measure hand under a long-life form
etymology: Simplified from 壽: the long winding road of years — long life, felicitations.
mnemonic: Years stacked with a bow on top — ことぶき. 寿司: named 'felicitous' — and it is.

etymology: Compound: waiting under the rain (雨) — what one waits needing: demand.
mnemonic: Standing in the rain until supply arrives — ジュ. 需要: the market's umbrella-less crowd.

etymology: Compound ideograph: a person (人) inside walls (囗) — the prisoner, drawn literally.
mnemonic: The kanji is its own cell — シュウ. 囚人: the diagram with a name.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 秋 (phonetic シュウ) + heart (心) — the autumn heart: melancholy.
mnemonic: The season falls inside the chest — うれい. 郷愁: homesickness in October light.

etymology: Compound: the grain stalk that outgrows the field — standing above: excellent.
mnemonic: One ear taller than the harvest — ひいでる. 優秀: the transcript word.

etymology: Compound ideograph: the nose (自) of the dog (犬) — smell itself; gone bad: stink.
mnemonic: What the dog's nose finds first — くさい. 臭い: socks, drains, cover-ups.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 龍 (phonetic シュウ) + 衣 — layered robes: to inherit (襲名); falling on like a cloak: to attack.
mnemonic: The dragon drops from above wearing your ancestor's coat — おそう. 襲撃 and 世襲: raids and dynasties.

etymology: Phono-semantic: jar (酉) + 州 (phonetic シュウ) — the answering toast: to reciprocate, reward.
mnemonic: The return pour — シュウ. 報酬: the toast in currency form.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 酉 (phonetic シュウ) + 鬼 — the drunken demon face: ugly, shameful.
mnemonic: The ghost after the third jar — みにくい. 醜い: conduct more often than faces.

etymology: Pictograph: a child grown to fill its frame — filled: to fill, be sufficient.
mnemonic: Topped up to the line — あてる. 充電: filling the battery — and yourself on weekends.

etymology: Phono-semantic: liquid (氵) + 十 (phonetic ジュウ) — the essence pressed out: juice, broth.
mnemonic: Ten drops of the good part — しる. みそ汁: the daily bowl.

etymology: Compound (simplified from 澁): water that puckers and stalls — astringent; movement that stalls: hesitant, congested (渋滞).
mnemonic: The persimmon that seizes your mouth — しぶい. 渋谷: astringent valley — now the least hesitant crossing on earth.

etymology: Compound (simplified from 獸): the hunt with dogs (犬) — the quarry: beast.
mnemonic: Everything the hunt was for — けもの. 野獣: the beast of the fairy tale.

etymology: Phono-semantic: metal (金) + 充 (phonetic ジュウ) — the loaded barrel: firearm.
mnemonic: Metal, filled — ジュウ. 銃: the kanji Japan reads more than sees.

etymology: Phono-semantic origin as 'to gather beans'; borrowed for the third brother: the younger uncle.
mnemonic: The younger of dad's brothers — シュク. 叔父さん: the uncle who spoils you.

etymology: Phono-semantic: water (氵) + 叔 (phonetic シュク) — clear as still water: virtuous, refined (of women, classically).
mnemonic: Composure like an unrippled pond — シュク. 淑女: the textbook lady.

etymology: Compound (simplified from 肅): work done with held breath — solemn, hushed, strict.
mnemonic: The room where everyone straightens — シュク. 厳粛: gravity, ceremonial strength.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 孰 (phonetic ジュク) + earth (土) — the gatehouse school: private academy.
mnemonic: Where evenings go to study — ジュク. 塾: the second school after school.

etymology: Phono-semantic: person (亻) + 夋 (phonetic シュン) — the one who outpaces: talented.
mnemonic: Quickest mind in the row — シュン. 俊足: the fast legs version.
